footnote_text: These shares represent restricted stock units and will be settled in LEDS common stock upon vesting, 25% of the restricted stock units will vest on February 23, 2027, May 23, 2027, August 23, 2027 and November 23, 2027, as long as the Reporting Person's continuous services through the applicable vesting date. In the event that the 2027 annual meeting of stockholders falls before November 23, 2027, 100% of the stock units shall immediately vest on the date of the 2027 annual meeting of stockholders.
